metadata.title: नर्मदा जी की बिना कांटे की मछली- दुर्गा ने पकाई | Fish cooked on the banks of Narmada River
metadata.description: Narmada is one of the rivers in India which is considered sacred by the large population. The government has constructed a huge dam on this river, which is called Bargi dam. This dam has submerged around 162 villages in the area. Many hills have become islands. A few of the families have settled on these Islands and survive on fishing from the water of Narmada.
